items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And at that time he did "I'll Be Around," which we did and we did do a record of that, and that's the band that's on that record... Mildred had did five shows with a cold at the Paramount and so hoarse she couldn't talk. And we went over to Lederkranz Studio and recorded four sides, one of them was

ctx.x: And then he tried to help, he played enough he could read and take --play parts. He was trying to show me what he could. He said, 'I'm really not a xylophone player. He said that's just a sideline with me because I'm a drummer.' MS VANCE: Yeah.
He said, 'But if I can help you, I will.' But I paid him. And I took a few lessons from him and then
